quality.title: Support quality
quality.descriptionAdmin: Track response progress, ticket resolution and the customer support experience.
quality.descriptionStaff: Prioritize tickets nearing their deadline, track performance and review your support.
quality.loadError: Could not load data. Please try again.
quality.queueDescription: Shows the current handling cycle, prioritizing the nearest deadline. This filter covers all tracked tickets, not limited to the report period.
quality.staffOnlyNote: Only tickets assigned to your account are shown.
quality.staffLoadError: Could not load the staff list.
quality.autoRefreshNote: Data refreshes every 30 seconds. Older untracked tickets remain in the
quality.savedNote: Settings saved. Tracked tickets keep their current deadlines.
quality.policiesDescription: Admin only. Deadlines run continuously 24/7, including weekends; maximum 30 days.
quality.policiesNotice: Changes apply to new tickets and the next reopened cycle. In-progress tickets keep their assigned deadlines. Turning off “Accept new tickets” does not stop tracking recorded tickets, even when they are reopened.
quality.chartAria: Chart of cycles started and resolved
quality.chartHint: Hover, tap or Tab into a column to see figures. Periods over 31 days are grouped in 7-day buckets.
quality.reportDescription: Select handling cycles started within the period. A reopened ticket gets an additional cycle.
quality.validationRange: Maximum range is 366 days; the end date cannot be before the start date.
quality.staffOnlyStats: Only statistics for work and ratings related to you.
quality.metricSatisfactionNote: {{count}} ratings for cycles in this period
quality.trendDescription: Start and resolution dates of cycles in the selected period. Cycles resolved outside the period still count in aggregate metrics but do not appear on in-period date columns.
quality.staffPerfDescription: Responses are credited to the first responder; resolutions and ratings to the person who closes the cycle.
quality.methodology1: On-time rate = cycles meeting the deadline / cycles with a result or already overdue. Pending cycles still within the deadline are excluded from the denominator. Tickets closed without a staff reply count as missing the response deadline.
quality.methodology2: Average time only covers cycles that have a reply / resolution. “—” means there is no data to compute yet.
quality.methodology3: {{count}} tickets created in this period have no deadline data. Their outcomes are not guessed into the rates; ratings of older tickets remain visible in the ticket detail.
quality.methodology4: AI, customer messages and claiming a ticket do not count as a first response. Reopening a ticket creates a new cycle and keeps the old cycle history.

ticketQuality.noDeadlineData: This ticket has no deadline-tracking data yet. Tickets created before the feature was enabled, or whose priority paused tracking, are not counted as overdue retroactively.
